## Purpose and Scope of This Report

The question "How big is the AntiScam dataset?" is deceptively simple, because the size of a conversational corpus can be measured along several independent axes: the raw number of conversations, the number of conversations that carry manual annotation, the number of annotated sentences, the per-conversation dimensions of turns and utterances, and the breadth of the annotation label space applied to the data.
